changes.text: Improved validation checks for missions that have been edited by hand. This change may invalidate some arcs, which will have to be republished
Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash if you used one of the costume change emotes and any shape shifting power in rapid succession.

Fixed a costume change timer bug where costume changes could occur in 15 seconds. If a character has more than one Costume Slot, and they change their costume, they will have to wait 30 seconds until they can change to another costume.
